scope: One existing candidate only: exact 8015-P2/MFN2-CMT2A article/exposure, human-function/model/allele and product/capture review with marginal-dollar integration. Broader new-opportunity screening excluded.

selection.objective: Expected discounted financial value retained by ddiscov after remaining development costs, commercial costs, rights payments, sharing and financing.
